thing.name: a single clock hand, the minute hand, pointing at 12
thing.body: One hand from a clock that has no face, no housing, and no other hand. It points at twelve. Twelve is where things begin and where they begin again. The hand is brass, polished, slightly warm from being held. It was not removed from a clock. It was made for a clock that has not been built yet. Open to anyone who needs a beginning.
thing.on_use: Using it puts no labels on you.
thing.end_program_summary: When this ends it becomes a remnant.
